steps.content: The man's voice grows even more repressed on the other end of the communication device.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: You... can't find its true location?

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: ...The visible contamination erupting now is only a ploy. The real Mania has already <color=#fb9259>covered</color> the entire camp?
The atmosphere is suffocating.

steps.speaker: Options
options: Send everyone away. Evacuate the Drifter Camp.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Make something up. Blame it on the Executive Committee's deed earlier.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You all must leave.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: ...We've tried that before, but it's impossible to evacuate everyone. They're very reluctant.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Some people even suspect that Rustfire has turned to the Executive Committee because of our cooperation, and we are coaxing people to leave the Drifter Camp.

steps.speaker: Options
options: How about contacting the FAC? I can help you communicate with them.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: The affairs of the West District are controlled by the Executive Committee, and even if you intend to refute their decisions, it will take time. But we don't have any time left.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: The executive officers' suppression and the gangsters' revenge are waiting for them out there. Even if you straight up tell them a Black Ring is coming, most people lack the courage to step out.

steps.speaker: Options
options: Shouldn't you be the one who gives them the courage?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're the leader here. If even you've lost the will to fight, how can they march on?

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Who cares about a cripple's will? He can't even protect himself.
Silence takes over on the other end of the conversation. When he speaks again, he's already calmed down.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: ...People only rely on the temporary shelter I've reconstructed. They only come to me when they've lost all their courage to fight.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: This is not the Legion. There isn't another Zoya.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: We'll try our best to arrange the evacuation. If you're still determined to chase after it, go back to <color=#fb9259>Romanesque</color>.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: In the process of evacuating house by house, we found some folks who died alone of Mania corruption. We've sent some of the bodies there.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: That Sinner, who walks side by side with death, is taciturn with us. Her only friend Dudu hasn't awakened either. But she may be willing to help you.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Even if people expect or request something from me, they will soon understand that I cannot do anything for them.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Thank you.
The call ends. Next, an announcement is broadcast throughout the entire camp.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: The Drifter Camp has launched the evacuation procedures. All inhabitants please follow Rustfire members to the shelters.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Keep calm. Stay rational. Support each other. We've overcome countless hardships before, and we'll do it again this time. I repeat...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, are you sure you want to continue? You've been looking unwell for sometime now.
Hecate looks at you worriedly. Come to think of it, touching the <color=#fb9259>scorch marks</color> with the shackles didn't affect them much, but the side effect on you is long-lasting.
You try your best to squeeze out a smile.

steps.speaker: Options
options: I'm fine. I want to try Greta's essence oil.

steps.content: She fumbles for the oil and rubs a drop onto your temple. The strange fragrance reminds you of the sweaty yoga session and that Outlander with a pink headscarf. You quiver all over, and find your mind surprisingly clearer now.
It's not over yet. There are still other things you can do.

You're back to the chilly bottom of the camp. You pass through that narrow passage in the dark, push open the iron gate, walk through the silent hall piled with wooden boxes, and arrive at the graveyard with the monument.
Romanesque, where the dead are remembered. As if separated from the outside world, there are no Corruptors here, no panicking crowd. The living's turmoil can never invade this place.

Oak Casket sits in front of the monument, blended with the pure silence behind and completely unaware of your arrival. The eerie atmosphere almost makes you forget the speech you've rehearsed multiple times, anxiety creeping into your mind.
She doesn't respond, only wearing a faint smile on her face. But Hecate reacts quickly.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: She's been corrupted by Mania?! Does the Corpus want this Sinner too? Like how it took over Zoya in BR-004?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief!

You grab onto her and shake her a few times. No response. You vaguely sense Mania gathering. Are there too many bodies of Mania victims here that the <color=#fb9259>Resonance</color> has devoured her?

The moment you connect to her, you fall into an icy cave with your hearing, smelling, and vision completely deprived. After a few seconds of silence, countless woeful cries and wails return to your consciousness slowly.

Burning filth rains down from above, spattering all over the tip of the monument, the chilly soil, and the silent master of the hall. The filth gathers to form grotesque shapes, wailing and approaching Oak Casket!
